@kwame.adjei-rowe, I can't confirm the Saltmarsh discount from anything I can see.

The only figure I found is in this channel from Nov 17. Bettina posted 12%, then corrected it the same afternoon to 10%, saying she had misread June's draft worksheet. I couldn't find a signed contract or order form for Saltmarsh in the files I can read, so I can't say what the current number is. Please check with June Osei-Lark before the brief goes out. Anything over 10% also needs Anselm Grieve's approval, so the brief shouldn't show 12% as settled.
